question: What should I do if I receive an unexpected login approval notification?

retrieved_documents.title: Incident Reporting Policy
retrieved_documents.content: Employees must immediately report suspected phishing emails, compromised credentials, malware infections, or unauthorized account activity to the security operations team.

retrieved_documents.title: Multi-Factor Authentication Policy
retrieved_documents.content: All employees must use multi-factor authentication when accessing corporate email, VPN services, and internal applications. Employees should report unexpected MFA approval requests to the security team.

retrieved_documents.title: Remote Access Policy
retrieved_documents.content: Employees working remotely must use an approved company VPN when connecting to protected internal resources. Remote connections must comply with device security and authentication requirements.
